interface.description: Network interface to listen on (e.g., eth0); required on some systems for pcap to work.

pcap_file.description: Read captured packets from a pcap file instead of capturing live traffic.

not_promiscuous.description: Do not put the interface into promiscuous mode.

adjunct_mode.description: Operate in adjunct mode — save images to a temp directory and write filenames to stdout.

adjunct_max_images.description: In adjunct mode, silently drop images if there are more than this number in temp dir.

image_prefix.description: Filename prefix for saved image files.

temp_dir.description: Directory to use for temporary image files in adjunct mode.

capture_audio.description: Attempt to capture and play MPEG audio streams.

audio_player.description: Command to execute for playing MPEG audio. Must accept MPEG frames on stdin. Array of argv tokens (first element = command, rest = args).

drop_user.description: Drop privileges to this user after starting pcap.

http_server.description: Enable built-in HTTP server to display images.

monitor_mode.description: Enable monitor mode on the interface (not supported on all interfaces).

filter_expr.description: Additional libpcap filter expression. Will be prepended with 'tcp and (', appended with ')'.
